intro.en: Nutrition, more food words, and how to describe the way something is cooked and how it tastes.

titulo.en: How it is cooked, how it tastes

texto.en:
The way food is cooked goes after the noun: pescado **a la plancha**, patatas **fritas**, huevo **hervido**, verdura **cruda**, pollo **asado**, carne **poco hecha** or **muy hecha**.

Taste takes **estar**: está **salado**, **dulce**, **amargo**, **soso**, **picante**, **rico**, **malo**.

**Sentar bien** / **mal** works like gustar: el marisco **me sienta mal**; las legumbres **te sientan bien**.

Nutrition: **una alimentación equilibrada**, **sana**, **variada**; **tener** vitaminas, proteínas, fibra, hierro, calorías.

Advice with the subjunctive: **es importante que comas** legumbres; **es mejor que evites** los fritos.

Substances take the article in general statements: **la** fruta tiene vitaminas; **el** aceite de oliva es sano.

frases.es: La dieta mediterránea se considera una de las más sanas del mundo.
frases.en: The Mediterranean diet is considered one of the healthiest in the world.
analisis: una de las más sanas del mundo

frases.es: Se basa en la fruta, la verdura, las legumbres, el pescado y el aceite de oliva.
frases.en: It is based on fruit, vegetables, pulses, fish and olive oil.
analisis: la fruta, la verdura, las legumbres
el pescado y el aceite de oliva

frases.es: Las lentejas y los garbanzos tienen muchas proteínas y mucha fibra.
frases.en: Lentils and chickpeas have a lot of protein and a lot of fibre.

frases.es: Se come poca carne roja y poco embutido, y el pescado suele hacerse a la plancha.
frases.en: Little red meat and little cured sausage are eaten, and fish is usually grilled.
analisis: poca carne roja y poco embutido

frases.es: Los médicos recomiendan que evitemos los fritos y la comida demasiado salada.
frases.en: Doctors recommend that we avoid fried food and food that is too salty.

frases.es: Pero no es solo lo que se come: también es importante comer despacio y en compañía.
frases.en: But it is not only what is eaten: it is also important to eat slowly and in company.

es.en: How a dish tastes takes estar.

pregunta.en: Complete: shellfish doesn't agree with me.

siente.en: Siente is from sentir, to feel.

pregunta.en: According to the text, what do lentils and chickpeas have?

comamos.en: Advice to someone else takes the subjunctive.

comer.en: With que you need a conjugated verb.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write about your diet: what you eat, what you should eat more or less of, and why.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Give your opinion aloud on fast food, vegetarian diets or eating at set times.
